sources.title: Pawmot（Rainier 卡号 sv1_en_076，特性 Electrogenesis）
sources.documentVersion: Limitless card page used by PTCGCardCN for this card's English image (Rainier sv1 → Limitless SVI); English card text from the Rainier card database 2026-10-07
sources.supportsZh: “Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.”：能量附到拥有这个特性的宝可梦，它在备战区时也一样。

sources.title: Sandy Shocks ex（Rainier 卡号 sv4_en_108，特性 Magnetic Absorption）
sources.documentVersion: Limitless card page used by PTCGCardCN for this card's English image (Rainier sv4 → Limitless PAR); English card text from the Rainier card database 2026-10-07
sources.supportsZh: “Once during your turn, if your opponent has 4 or fewer Prize cards remaining, you may attach a Basic {F} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.”：条件不满足时不能使用特性。

sources.title: Solgaleo（Rainier 卡号 me5-5_en_105，特性 Sunrise）
sources.documentVersion: Limitless card page used by PTCGCardCN for this card's English image (Rainier me5-5 → Limitless 30C); English card text from the Rainier card database 2026-10-07
sources.supportsZh: “Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {M} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon.”：只有在备战区时能用，能量附到这只备战宝可梦。

dataContractZh: attach_energy 新增目标 SELF（target_scope 必须是 OWN_FIELD，不能用 distribution ANY）：拥有这段文字的宝可梦本身，在战斗位或备战区都可以。训练家没有“这只宝可梦”，一律拒绝。
serverAuthorityZh: 宿主由服务器从效果来源取得，只在同一只宝可梦仍在场（入场身份没变）时有效；选完能量后直接附着，不给客户端第二次选宿主的机会，与 select_pokemon 绑定的宿主（CHOSEN_POKEMON）相同。顺带修正：CHOSEN_POKEMON 的附能／附着工具在选完卡后原来提前返回，没有继续推进卡牌结算，训练家／特性的结算一直挂着；现在与普通提交一样附着后继续结算。
limitations: 特性从手牌附能到这只宝可梦（Moltres／Articuno／Zapdos 的 “if you have … in play”）需要按卡名判断场上宝可梦，还没有对应条件。
